purpose: Record the current continuous-assurance posture for MVP Gate 09 without treating a green validation run as permanent health.
principles: A green CI run is snapshot evidence, not a permanent certificate.
Code, schemas, docs, generated artifacts, images, workflows, and governance records can all decay.
Quality, health, security, compliance, freshness, reproducibility, and boundary integrity require recurring review.
Assurance depth should be proportional to risk, public visibility, automation impact, and release authority.
Funding, promotion, or repository visibility must not bypass assurance gates.

assurance_dimensions.meaning: The artifact remains understandable, maintainable, coherent, and useful for its intended audience.
The repository or lane can still run its declared checks and has no obvious broken generated outputs.
The lane does not expose secrets, expand permissions silently, or introduce unsafe supply-chain behavior.
License, provenance, attribution, payment, privacy, and public-safe boundaries remain reviewable.
Claims, links, counts, screenshots, generated reports, and external references have not gone stale.
Generated outputs can be reproduced from declared source data and scripts.
Private overlays, local paths, account state, memory, credentials, and personal preferences remain out of public artifacts.
Runtime, install, routing, release, and rollback authority remains in the correct repository and approval boundary.

repository_assurance.risk_if_stale: Public hub claims, maps, support wording, and promotion material can mislead users if not refreshed.
repository_assurance.cadence_hint: on every public claim change, before promotion refresh, and at MVP closeout.

repository_assurance.risk_if_stale: A stale candidate, manifest, or routing projection can make an unapproved Skill look executable.
repository_assurance.cadence_hint: before candidate adaptation, before release-candidate manifest, and before consumer install.

repository_assurance.risk_if_stale: Private runtime state, memory snapshots, local paths, and install plans can drift from public-safe templates.
repository_assurance.cadence_hint: before memory sync, before curated Skill install, before rollback, and before public-safe pattern extraction.

repository_assurance.risk_if_stale: Private agent-specific commands, hooks, and memory can drift from the public template or leak subjective/private state.
repository_assurance.cadence_hint: before template extraction, hook changes, or public-safe memory/configuration claims.

repository_assurance.risk_if_stale: Candidate scoring, source metadata, and lifecycle state can become noisy or legally unsafe if not refreshed.
repository_assurance.cadence_hint: before publishing public-safe patterns, before proposing candidates to Skills, and after source policy changes.

repository_assurance.risk_if_stale: Demo claims may be mistaken for production discovery quality or private candidate truth.
repository_assurance.cadence_hint: before public README or demo-report changes.

repository_assurance.risk_if_stale: Private bookmark imports can contain personal behavior, local-only entries, duplicates, or outdated sources.
repository_assurance.cadence_hint: before public projection refresh and after browser import changes.

repository_assurance.risk_if_stale: Public browser-importable HTML and source taxonomy can become outdated or accidentally overclaim coverage.
repository_assurance.cadence_hint: before regenerated HTML import/export and before public promotion.

repository_assurance.risk_if_stale: Template placeholders can accidentally look like recommended personal settings or real private configuration.
Template commands or hooks can become unsafe or misleading as Claude Code behavior changes.
repository_assurance.cadence_hint: before absorbing private command, hook, or memory patterns.

completed_this_review: green CI is explicitly downgraded from permanent proof to snapshot evidence
public/private boundary drift is treated as an assurance dimension
runtime authority drift is treated as an assurance dimension
remaining_before_gate_pass: turn cadence hints into per-lane recurring or event-driven check records where needed
run final cross-repository assurance review after MVP-02 through MVP-06 evidence exists
record any accepted stale-risk exceptions or retire stale artifacts before global closeout
